description: This Java source file defines the EntityDataLoader class, which provides utility methods for loading seed data into the database, including retrieving data file URLs, parsing and loading XML data, and generating default data entries. The class interacts with various configuration and resource handling classes to locate data files and execute data loading procedures.

classes.name: EntityDataLoader
classes.description: Utility class for loading seed data into entities, parsing XML files, and generating default data entries.

methods.name: getPathsString
methods.description: Constructs a semicolon-separated string of file paths from the datasource configuration based on a helper name.

methods.name: getUrlList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of URLs for data files based on helper name and optional component or reader names.

methods.name: getUrlByComponentList
methods.description: Aggregates URLs for specified components and reader names.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads data from a given URL into the database, parsing XML and handling errors.

methods.name: generateData
methods.description: Generates default permissions and security entries for entities.
